nodes.title: Text Prompt
widgets_values:
[VISUAL]: Almost static camera, a barely perceptible drift forward over five seconds - the framing should look nearly the same at the start and at the end. He holds absolutely still, chin up, breathing slow. His eyes shift and lock forward with certainty. The smallest confident smile forms at one corner of his mouth. He does not fidget, does not tilt his head.

[SPEECH]: "Esse ano..."

[SOUNDS]: TIMING: he speaks in the FIRST SECOND of the shot and then stops completely. The remaining four seconds are pure silence with no speech at all, and he holds the look through all of it. He speaks very slowly and low, around 90 words per minute, with the calm of someone who already decided. No music. Distant city hum, one motorbike far away

A futuristic sidearm with an angular design. A handcrafted jury-rigged futuristic laser pistol laid horizontally on a seamless pale grey studio backdrop, shot in profile from the side. The compact weapon has a short hand-milled steel barrel wrapped loosely in thin copper wire, a single slim coolant tube threaded through the wooden grip and glowing a faint electric blue, a small scavenged phone battery taped into the rear housing, and a scratched brass charging tab. Crafted from thin metal plates, rusty and patched with exposed wires. Even, soft studio lighting from a large overhead softbox, no harsh shadows, subtle falloff toward the edges of the frame. Shot on an 85mm lens, razor sharp across the full length of the weapon, shallow depth of field falling off behind it. Neutral grey backdrop, product photography clarity. Use the drawing as rough layout.

nodes.title: Tip
widgets_values:
If you want to use voice reference, write your prompt in this structure:
[VISUAL]: <scene and appearance description>
[SPEECH]: <exact words the person should say>
[SOUNDS]: <speaker vocal style + ambient/environmental sounds>


Example:
[VISUAL]: A medium shot features a young man with curly brown hair and light blue eyes, sitting on a beige couch. He is wearing a light blue shirt and a red patterned tie. His mouth is slightly open as he speaks. In the background, there is a blurry room with warm lighting.
[SPEECH]: We are proud to introduce ID-LoRA.
[SOUNDS]: The speaker has a moderate volume and a conversational tone, sounding engaged and natural. They are close to the microphone. Light, instrumental background music plays softly, creating a calm atmosphere.

widgets_values: A 360 degree view from the middle of a dense urban favela in Sao Paulo, Brazil, at golden hour. Bare brick houses stacked steeply on top of each other, concrete alleys, blue plastic water tanks on the roofs, thick tangled power cables overhead, concrete underfoot - no dirt roads, no open countryside. Straight ahead at 0 degrees, a narrow concrete alley between tall bare brick walls, thick tangled power cables crossing low overhead, a few concrete steps, graffiti tags on the wall. At 90 degrees, a long concrete staircase climbing between stacked brick houses, a painted metal handrail, plants in paint cans on the steps, blue plastic water tanks on the roofs above. At 150 degrees, stacked unfinished brick houses piled on top of each other, exposed rebar, blue water tanks, laundry on the rooftops, and far in the distance the sao paulo skyline of grey towers under haze. At 210 degrees, a small concrete sports court with faded painted lines, metal goals, a tall wire fence around it, brick houses rising right behind the fence. At 270 degrees, a tight alley with clothes lines strung across between windows, iron gates, bicycles and a motorbike parked against the wall, satellite dishes bolted to the bricks. At 330 degrees, a small corner shop with a metal security grille, a hand painted sign, crates of fruit and crates of drinks stacked outside, plastic stools on the pavement. Warm late afternoon sunlight raking low between the buildings, long shadows. Completely empty of people. Camera at eye height, level horizon. Style: warm brazilian documentary realism, golden hour, muted warm palette, subtle film grain. Seamless equirectangular 360 degree spherical panorama, ERP projection, level horizon across the middle, straight lines curving near the edges.
